svg.text: PRISM — job lifecycle at the API
Submission is synchronous and cheap; processing is queued; progress is live-only.
multipart: one request JSON part + N input parts
fetch remote inputs to the job temp folder
build PrismJobRequest — no API types cross into core
SSE, live only — no replay, no polling
only the originating client may subscribe
call after a terminal progress event
after expiry the JobID is stale and
the client drops it from its state
acceptance status · active and queued counts
accepted media types · size and count limits
safe values only — never local paths
queued and running jobs are process-local;
Two synchronous side doors bypass the queue
entirely and answer in the request:
Both return just the old-name → new-name map.
